lines.text: Everyone's at the party except me!
I have serious FOMO when I see party photos.

data.define: The worry that others are having fun or doing something great without you.

example.text: I have serious FOMO when I see party photos.

misuse.text: Don't say 'FOMO' about a fear of spiders.

hook.text: Everyone's at the party except me!

publish.title: What does "FOMO" mean?
publish.value: FOMO = Fear of missing out. Example: "I have serious FOMO when I see party photos." (casual English).
